# Public graphics dependency

Three.js 0.185.1, copied unchanged from the project's existing licensed vendor
bundle. `three.module.min.js` imports `three.core.min.js` from this directory.
The upstream MIT license is in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.

These public copies support the portfolio's lazy-loaded capability gallery;
the private Mission Control vendor directory remains unchanged. No CDN,
remote textures, tracking, or API calls are used by the gallery.
